run_gripper_server: run a gRPC gripper server on localhost:50052 using GripperServerLauncher
launch_gripper_server_custom_port: launch a gripper server on a custom IP and port using GripperServerLauncher
init_robot_client: initialize a robot client by sending metadata to the gripper server via InitRobotClient
get_gripper_state: get the current gripper state cache from the server using the GetState RPC
send_gripper_command: send a gripper command to the server using the Goto RPC method
